title: Does a review by a second model find method-level problems the reader panel misses?
hypothesis: With the same reading copy and the same prompt, a model from a different vendor finds method-level problems in a full draft that a same-family reader panel does not. If so, DR-011's cross-vendor Pass 3 may belong before a full draft goes to an outside reader.
subject: DR-011 Pass 3 (cross-vendor review) against the reader panel, same prompt (agents/review-prompt.md)
judge: the paper's author, blind to which arm raised each finding

population.note: the next full draft of one private narrative review

decision_rationale: Preregistered before the draft is reviewed; no result yet. Bars, counting rules and the mapping to a decision are in the PREREGISTRATION.md.
notes: The draft and both reviews are private. The concluding entry's metrics will trace to an anonymised summary, so for a reader without the private files the metric check is circular (DR-024 rule 6).
